title: GPT 5.5 'Spud' reportedly in A/B testing inside ChatGPT
summary: OpenAI's next mid-cycle model, referred to as GPT 5.5 and codenamed 'Spud', is reported to be A/B tested inside ChatGPT. Early demos highlight gains in speed, token efficiency, reasoning, SVG and 3D generation, and front-end coding. Polymarket positioning suggests imminent release.

research.notes: Pre-release A/B leak; model name and timing not confirmed by OpenAI.
